<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFrameworks>netstandard2.0;net8.0</TargetFrameworks>
    <LangVersion>latest</LangVersion>
    <ImplicitUsings>disable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <RootNamespace>Aspose.Imaging.Foss</RootNamespace>
    <AssemblyName>Aspose.Imaging.Foss</AssemblyName>
    <GenerateDocumentationFile>true</GenerateDocumentationFile>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <PropertyGroup>
    <PackageId>Aspose.Imaging.Foss</PackageId>
    <Authors>Aspose</Authors>
    <Description>Zero-dependency image format detection and header probing for .NET. Identifies image formats and reads dimensions/basic metadata without a full pixel decode.</Description>
    <PackageLicenseExpression>MIT</PackageLicenseExpression>
    <PackageTags>image;format;detection;metadata;probe;dotnet</PackageTags>
    <RepositoryUrl>https://github.com/aspose-imaging-foss/Aspose.Imaging.Foss</RepositoryUrl>
    <PackageProjectUrl>https://github.com/aspose-imaging-foss/Aspose.Imaging.Foss</PackageProjectUrl>
  </PropertyGroup>

</Project>
